rachel.c: Hey all  brand new here. My first Buildkite pipeline for `redwood/data-validate` failed right at the artifact publish step with a 403 from GitHub. Any onboarding gotchas I missed?

buildkite-bot: Build #3 failed - step: publish-artifacts (exit code: 1)
```
Uploading artifacts to https://uploads.github.com/repos/redwood/data-validate/releases/77/assets
POST -> 403 Forbidden
Error: POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood/data-validate/releases/77/assets: 403 Forbidden
```

tom: Welcome! Most likely the publish step needs a release token (RELEASE_TOKEN) with repo scope. We don't rely on the implicit GITHUB_TOKEN for Buildkite. Did the onboarding page mention a release token?

rachel.c: I skimmed the onboarding checklist but didn't see a token step. I was expecting the pipeline to have everything.

ci-oncall-bot: Note for new hires: Do not create personal long-lived tokens. Request a scoped bot token from #eng-infra or use the release-operator service account.

infra-ali: I can add a temporary bot token to the pipeline so you can finish your first build. Long term we'll rotate you to the release-operator identity. Also check that the Buildkite GitHub App is installed for the repo (https://github.com/apps/buildkite/installations).

rachel.c: How do I re-run only the publish step after the secret is added?

tom: In Buildkite UI, open the failed job, click "Rebuild" -> "Rebuild from here". After adding SECRET_RELEASE_TOKEN (masked) to the pipeline env, re-run that step.

infra-ali: Temp token added as SECRET_RELEASE_TOKEN (masked). Re-run whenever you're ready.

rachel.c: Re-ran and now I see 201 Created for the asset upload  looks good! Thanks so much.

tom: Nice. Follow-ups for infra: add a bullet in the new-hire checklist about requesting a release token or using release-operator, and add a preflight check in pipelines to error early if token missing.

infra-ali: Will do. Also for repos with private submodules, shout if you hit checkout 403s; we either add the repo to the Buildkite app install or provide a read-only deploy key.

rachel.c: Appreciate it. Saved my first-day panic. Happy to PR a small onboarding doc change once I find the right page.

buildkite-bot: Build #3 (re-run) passed - step: publish-artifacts :white_check_mark:
